title: Udyam registration: what it is and why it matters
summary: A plain guide to Udyam registration for small businesses.

sections.heading: What is Udyam registration?
paragraphs: Udyam registration is the government's registration for micro, small and medium enterprises (MSMEs).

sections.heading: Why do people register?
paragraphs: A registration can help your business be recognised as an MSME. This can matter for some government schemes and rules. Check what applies to you.

sections.heading: How to register
paragraphs: Registration is done on the official Udyam portal. Check the portal for the steps.
